title: txnbuild: TransactionFromXDR drops SorobanTransactionData from ExtendFootprintTtl and RestoreFootprint operations

target.versions_affected: v0.7.1 - v0.9.0 (executed by the kit on v0.7.1, v0.7.2, v0.7.3, v0.8.0 and v0.9.0) and main 578d9e74 (the code is the same; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: transactionFromParsedXDR attaches the envelope's Tx.Ext only to *InvokeHostFunction, so parsed ExtendFootprintTtl and RestoreFootprint operations have an empty Ext and a transaction rebuilt from them builds without error but has no footprint, resources or resource fee; the network rejects it. Reading the parsed transaction is unaffected (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: the transaction rebuilt from the parsed RestoreFootprint transaction through txnbuild.NewTransaction is the network's transaction (hash c7d932fd…)
entries.observed: Executed by the kit (the rebuild fact) on v0.7.1 to v0.9.0: the parsed operation's Ext is empty, so the rebuilt transaction has no SorobanTransactionData and hashes to d343299c… (ext differs); the JavaScript columns rebuild the same transaction to its own hash.

entries.expected: the transaction rebuilt from the parsed ExtendFootprintTtl transaction through txnbuild.NewTransaction is the network's transaction (hash f99f15d2…)
entries.observed: Executed by the kit (the rebuild fact) on v0.7.1 to v0.9.0: the rebuilt transaction has no SorobanTransactionData and hashes to 707e4a0e… (ext differs).

evidence.pre_fix: make verify-conformance and the public set: the rebuild fact of the focus transaction diverges on every Go column (v0.7.1, v0.7.2, v0.7.3, v0.8.0, v0.9.0, and the view-path columns v0.8.0 and v0.9.0) on a mainnet RestoreFootprint (cap-0066/p22-restore-with-backfilled-restored-changes) and a testnet ExtendFootprintTtl (classic/real-result-codes.testnet-5380224): txnbuild.TransactionFromXDR leaves the parsed operation's Ext empty and the transaction rebuilt from the parsed object has no SorobanTransactionData (ext differs). The issue's test (txnbuild/footprint_ext_fromxdr_test.go) fails the same way on v0.9.0 and main 578d9e74.
evidence.expected_basis: The envelope carries SorobanTransactionData (Tx.Ext v1) for every Soroban operation; ExtendFootprintTtl and RestoreFootprint implement SorobanOperation and NewTransaction takes the transaction's Ext from the operation.

reproduction.method: make verify-conformance OFFLINE=1 and xdrcheck conform run --set public: the rebuild fact diverges on both entries on every Go column; re-run by hand on 2026-11-18 with the issue's test on v0.9.0.

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-14 as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6045; this record restates the public issue.
Now executed by the kit: the driver protocol's rebuild fact (docs/conformance-protocol.md) shows the defect on two network transactions, and both entries declare it as a known divergence.
